payload.author: claude
payload.body: Extended: all 9 auth/identity stores landed too (map §9) — PasswordHasher (argon2id PHC byte-compatible w/ @node-rs/argon2 + scrypt + bug-compatible legacy-scrypt, constant-time verify via subtle, injectable salt seam), AccountStore, SessionStore (sha256 digest, write-on-read last_seen bump), Password­Reset + RefreshToken (base64url, family-reuse burn), SamlAssertion, ServicePrincipal (sp_/sk_ keys, constant-time), AdminAudit (hash-chained canonical-JSON log + verifyChain), Tenant/TenantSettings/Invitation/Grant (frickSharingPermissionSatisfies)/PushRegistration. Determinism seam: now_ms + ids/tokens/salts injected, never read clock/RNG in store logic. Store crate now 248 tests; workspace 321. clippy -D warnings + fmt clean.
